sentences.en: Choose a communication link. Would you prefer fewer hidden mistakes or more marked blanks?
sentences.zh: 选择一条通信链路：你更愿意要较少的隐蔽错误，还是较多但有标记的空缺？

sentences.en: Link A flips each bit independently with probability .10. Its output never marks a flip.
sentences.zh: 链路A以0.10的概率独立翻转每个比特，输出不标记哪里翻转了。

sentences.en: Link B independently erases a bit with probability .40. Every erased position is explicitly marked.
sentences.zh: 链路B以0.40的概率独立擦除一个比特，并明确标记每个被擦除的位置。

sentences.en: Both spend one channel use per input bit. Which has the larger information capacity?
sentences.zh: 两条链路每输入一个比特都用一次信道。哪条的信息容量更大？

sentences.en: Keep that choice open. We must count what the receiver learns, beyond how often a symbol changes.
sentences.zh: 先保留你的选择。除了符号改变的频率，还要计算接收者究竟获得了多少信息。

sentences.en: A discrete memoryless channel has finite input and output alphabets.
sentences.zh: 离散无记忆信道具有有限输入字母表和输出字母表。

sentences.en: Its transition kernel W gives the conditional law of output Y given input X.
sentences.zh: 转移核W给出给定输入X时输出Y的条件分布。

sentences.en: Each row contains nonnegative probabilities summing to one.
sentences.zh: 每一行都是和为一的非负概率。

sentences.en: Choose an input distribution P X before using the channel.
sentences.zh: 使用信道前先选择输入分布P_X。

sentences.en: The joint law is P X of x times W of y given x.
sentences.zh: 联合分布为P_X(x)W(y|x)。

sentences.en: The output law sums this joint probability over input values.
sentences.zh: 输出分布需对输入值求和联合概率。

sentences.en: For example, use rows (.9,.1) and (.2,.8).
Let input probabilities for zero and one be .25 and .75.
sentences.zh: 令输入0和1的概率分别为.25和.75。

sentences.en: The joint probability of input zero and output zero is .225.
sentences.zh: 输入0且输出0的联合概率为.225。

sentences.en: Input zero and output one has probability .025.
sentences.zh: 输入0且输出1的概率为.025。

sentences.en: Input one and output zero has probability .15.
sentences.zh: 输入1且输出0的概率为.15。

sentences.en: Input one and output one has probability .6.
sentences.zh: 输入1且输出1的概率为.6。

sentences.en: Sum over the two input rows at each output to get probabilities .375 and .625.
sentences.zh: 对每个输出沿两个输入行求和，得到输出概率.375和.625。

sentences.en: The input distribution is a prior chosen by the sender.
sentences.zh: 输入分布是发送者选择的先验。

sentences.en: The transition rows describe randomness imposed by the channel.
sentences.zh: 转移行描述信道施加的随机性。

sentences.en: These are distinct ingredients of the joint law.
sentences.zh: 它们是联合分布中的不同要素。

sentences.en: The channel is memoryless when repeated uses factor conditionally.
sentences.zh: 当重复使用在给定输入后条件分解时，信道无记忆。

sentences.en: For n input and output symbols, W n equals the product of single-use transitions.
sentences.zh: 对n个输入输出符号，Wⁿ等于各次单用转移的乘积。

sentences.en: The output conditional law at each use depends only on that use’s input.
sentences.zh: 每次使用的输出条件分布仅依赖当次输入。

sentences.en: It does not require the input symbols themselves to be independent.
sentences.zh: 它不要求输入符号本身相互独立。

sentences.en: A channel with hidden state may fail this factorization.
sentences.zh: 具有隐藏状态的信道可能不满足该分解。

sentences.en: For one use, mutual information depends on both P X and W.
sentences.zh: 单次使用时，互信息同时依赖P_X和W。

sentences.en: Define the information capacity as the maximum mutual information over input laws.
sentences.zh: 定义信息容量为所有输入分布上的最大互信息。

sentences.en: C equals max over P X of I of X and Y.
sentences.zh: C=max_{P_X}I(X;Y)。

sentences.en: This is a single-use mathematical definition.
sentences.zh: 这是单次使用的数学定义。

sentences.en: We have not yet proved any operational coding theorem.
sentences.zh: 我们尚未证明任何操作性编码定理。

sentences.en: The maximization asks which input distribution best uses this channel.
sentences.zh: 该最大化问题询问哪种输入分布最能利用此信道。

sentences.en: For the example matrix, different input weights change the output law.
sentences.zh: 对该示例矩阵，不同输入权重会改变输出分布。

sentences.en: That in turn changes the mutual information.
sentences.zh: 这又会改变互信息。

sentences.en: Next, solve the maximization explicitly for a binary symmetric channel.
sentences.zh: 接下来对二元对称信道显式求解该最大化问题。

scenes.title: The fair input maximizes its mutual information

sentences.en: A binary symmetric channel flips its input bit with probability p.
sentences.zh: 二元对称信道以概率p翻转输入比特。

sentences.en: The row for zero is one minus p, then p. The row for one is p, then one minus p.
sentences.zh: 其转移行是(1−p,p)与(p,1−p)。

sentences.en: Equivalently, output Y is X exclusive-or noise N.
sentences.zh: 等价地，输出Y=X异或噪声N。

sentences.en: The noise bit is independent of X and Bernoulli with parameter p.
sentences.zh: 噪声比特独立于X，且服从参数为p的伯努利分布。

sentences.en: Let the letter A denote the probability that input X equals one.
sentences.zh: 令a表示输入X为1的概率。

sentences.en: Output one occurs when input and noise differ.
sentences.zh: 输入与噪声不同时，输出为1。

sentences.en: Its probability is p times one minus A, plus one minus p times A.
sentences.zh: 其概率为p(1−a)+(1−p)a。

sentences.en: This simplifies to p plus the product of one minus two p and A.
sentences.zh: 化简为p+(1−2p)a。

sentences.en: Given either input, the output uncertainty is binary entropy of p.
sentences.zh: 给定任一输入，输出不确定性均为H_b(p)。

sentences.en: Therefore I of X and Y equals output entropy minus H b of p.
sentences.zh: 因此I(X;Y)=H(Y)−H_b(p)。

sentences.en: Take binary entropy of this output probability, then subtract binary entropy of p.
sentences.zh: 写成a的函数即H_b(p+(1−2p)a)−H_b(p)。

sentences.en: Output entropy cannot exceed one bit.
sentences.zh: 输出熵至多为一比特。

sentences.en: A fair input has bias one half and makes the output fair.
sentences.zh: 输入公平即a=1/2时，输出也公平。

sentences.en: That achieves output entropy one while conditional entropy stays H b of p.
sentences.zh: 此时输出熵为一，条件熵仍是H_b(p)。

sentences.en: So capacity is one minus H b of p.
sentences.zh: 所以容量C=1−H_b(p)。

sentences.en: When p equals zero point one, capacity is about zero point five three one bits per use.
sentences.zh: 当p=0.1时，容量约为每次使用0.531比特。

sentences.en: This value is a formula calculation, not a measured performance result.
sentences.zh: 该数值由公式计算得出，并非性能测量结果。

sentences.en: When p equals zero, the channel copies every input exactly.
sentences.zh: 当p=0时，信道精确复制每个输入。

sentences.en: Its capacity is one bit per use.
sentences.zh: 其容量为每次使用一比特。

sentences.en: When p equals one half, both rows are identical and output is independent of input.
sentences.zh: 当p=1/2时，两行相同，输出独立于输入。

sentences.en: Every input law then gives zero mutual information.
sentences.zh: 此时任意输入分布都给出零互信息。

sentences.en: Thus capacity is zero at the half-flip point.
sentences.zh: 因此翻转概率为二分之一时容量为零。

sentences.en: At p equal one, every bit flips. Is all information lost?
sentences.zh: 当p等于一，每个比特都翻转。信息就全部丢失了吗？

sentences.en: The receiver can invert that deterministic mapping.
sentences.zh: 接收端可以反转该确定性映射。

sentences.en: Capacity returns to one bit per use.
sentences.zh: 容量重新达到每次使用一比特。

sentences.en: The bias formula is symmetric about input bias one half.
sentences.zh: 偏置公式也显示关于a=1/2的对称性。

sentences.en: For p below one half, the output bias is reduced toward one half.
sentences.zh: 当p<1/2时，输出偏置被压向二分之一。

sentences.en: A fair input maximizes output entropy and hence mutual information.
sentences.zh: 公平输入使输出熵最大，因而使互信息最大。

sentences.en: The output-entropy upper bound is attained because the fair input makes each output equally likely.
sentences.zh: 公平输入使各输出等概率，因此达到输出熵上界。

sentences.en: Next, replace flipping with an explicit erasure symbol.
sentences.zh: 接下来用显式擦除符号取代翻转。

scenes.title: Erasure leaves uncertainty only on erased uses

sentences.en: A binary erasure channel outputs zero, one, or an erasure marker.
sentences.zh: 二元擦除信道输出0、1或擦除标记。

sentences.en: Let the erasure probability be epsilon.
sentences.zh: 令擦除概率为ε。

sentences.en: With probability one minus epsilon, the input bit is revealed exactly.
sentences.zh: 以概率1−ε，输入比特被精确揭示。

sentences.en: With probability epsilon, the output is the marker.
sentences.zh: 以概率ε，输出为擦除标记。

sentences.en: The erasure event is independent of the input bit.
sentences.zh: 擦除事件独立于输入比特。

sentences.en: If the output is zero or one, the conditional entropy of X is zero.
sentences.zh: 若输出为0或1，X的条件熵为零。

sentences.en: If the output is erased, the receiver retains the prior uncertainty H of X.
sentences.zh: 若输出被擦除，接收端仍保留先验不确定性H(X)。

sentences.en: Average these cases using their event probabilities.
sentences.zh: 按两种事件概率对结果取平均。

sentences.en: The conditional entropy H of X given Y equals epsilon times H of X.
sentences.zh: 条件熵H(X|Y)=εH(X)。

sentences.en: Subtract from H of X to obtain mutual information.
sentences.zh: 用H(X)减去它，得到互信息。

sentences.en: Mutual information equals H of X multiplied by one minus epsilon.
sentences.zh: 互信息等于H(X)乘以(1−ε)。

sentences.en: Binary entropy is maximized by a fair input.
sentences.zh: 二元熵在公平输入时最大。

sentences.en: Therefore BEC capacity is one minus epsilon bits per use.
sentences.zh: 因此BEC容量为每次使用1−ε比特。

sentences.en: The linear factor counts the probability of a revealed input.
sentences.zh: 线性因子表示输入被揭示的概率。

sentences.en: An erased symbol means unknown, not an incorrectly flipped bit.
sentences.zh: 擦除符号表示未知，而不是被错误翻转的比特。

sentences.en: A BSC with the same numerical parameter has a different observation law.
sentences.zh: 数值参数相同的BSC具有不同的观测分布。

sentences.en: A BSC output always names a bit, though it may be wrong.
sentences.zh: BSC输出始终是某个比特，只是可能错误。

sentences.en: A BEC output explicitly tells the receiver when information is missing.
sentences.zh: BEC输出会明确告诉接收端信息何时缺失。

sentences.en: The formulas compare single-use mutual information.
sentences.zh: 这些公式比较的是单次使用互信息。

sentences.en: They do not by themselves rank operational systems under every protocol.
sentences.zh: 仅凭这些公式不能对所有协议下的操作系统排序。

sentences.en: For epsilon zero, no symbols are erased and capacity is one.
sentences.zh: ε=0时没有符号被擦除，容量为一。

sentences.en: For epsilon one, every output is erased and capacity is zero.
sentences.zh: ε=1时所有输出都被擦除，容量为零。

sentences.en: Return to the opening choice: .10 hidden flips, or .40 marked erasures. Which has larger capacity?
sentences.zh: 回到开头的选择：0.10概率的隐蔽翻转，还是0.40概率的标记擦除，哪条容量更大？

sentences.en: Link A gives about zero point five three one bits per use. Link B gives zero point six. The more frequently marked blank wins here.
sentences.zh: 链路A约为每次0.531比特，链路B为0.6。这里出现标记空缺更频繁的链路胜出。

sentences.en: The erasure marker is part of the observation. Both numbers use one binary input per channel use.
sentences.zh: 擦除标记也是观测的一部分。这两个数都按每次信道输入一个二进制符号计算。

sentences.en: Counting symbol changes alone misses what the receiver knows.
sentences.zh: 只统计符号改变，会忽略接收者掌握的信息。

sentences.en: Next, use row symmetry to solve a broader channel family.
sentences.zh: 接下来利用行对称性求解更一般的信道族。

scenes.title: Equal row entropy and column sums certify a uniform output

sentences.en: Consider a channel whose rows are permutations of one another.
sentences.zh: 考虑各行互为排列的信道。

sentences.en: Assume also that all column sums are equal.
sentences.zh: 并假设所有列的列和相等。

sentences.en: This is the weak symmetry condition used here.
sentences.zh: 这就是此处采用的弱对称条件。

sentences.en: Permuting entries does not change entropy.
sentences.zh: 排列概率项不会改变熵。

sentences.en: Thus every transition row has the same entropy.
sentences.zh: 因此每个转移行具有相同熵。

sentences.en: Call this common row entropy h row.
sentences.zh: 将共同的行熵称为h_row。

sentences.en: For any input distribution, H of Y given X equals h row.
sentences.zh: 对任意输入分布，H(Y|X)=h_row。

sentences.en: The output alphabet size is m.
sentences.zh: 令输出字母表大小为m。

sentences.en: Output entropy is at most log two m.
sentences.zh: 输出熵至多为log₂m。

sentences.en: Therefore every input gives mutual information at most log two m minus h row.
sentences.zh: 因此任意输入的互信息至多为log₂m−h_row。

sentences.en: Now choose the uniform distribution over input symbols.
sentences.zh: 现在令输入符号服从均匀分布。

sentences.en: Each output probability equals its column sum divided by the number of inputs.
sentences.zh: 每个输出概率等于对应列和除以输入数。

sentences.en: Equal column sums therefore make output probabilities equal.
sentences.zh: 列和相等，因此输出概率也相等。

sentences.en: The output is uniform over its m symbols.
sentences.zh: 输出在m个符号上均匀分布。

sentences.en: Its entropy reaches log two m.
sentences.zh: 其熵达到log₂m。

sentences.en: Thus the upper bound is attained by uniform input.
sentences.zh: 因此均匀输入达到该上界。

sentences.en: Capacity equals log two m minus h row.
sentences.zh: 容量C=log₂m−h_row。

sentences.en: This proof uses only row permutations and equal column sums.
sentences.zh: 此证明只使用行排列和列和相等。

sentences.en: It does not assume an input permutation group for every such channel.
sentences.zh: 它没有假设每个此类信道都有输入置换群。

sentences.en: Consider a four-symbol typewriter channel.
sentences.zh: 考虑四符号打字机信道。

sentences.en: Given input x, output x or x plus one modulo four, each with probability one half.
sentences.zh: 给定输入x，输出以各二分之一概率为x或x+1模4。

sentences.en: Each row has entropy one bit.
sentences.zh: 每一行的熵为一比特。

sentences.en: The rows are cyclic permutations.
sentences.zh: 各行互为循环排列。

sentences.en: Each column receives total probability one across all four rows.
sentences.zh: 四行中每列的概率总和为一。

sentences.en: Uniform input therefore produces uniform output over four symbols.
sentences.zh: 因此均匀输入产生四符号均匀输出。

sentences.en: Output entropy is two bits and conditional entropy is one.
sentences.zh: 输出熵为二比特，条件熵为一比特。

sentences.en: The channel capacity is one bit per use.
sentences.zh: 信道容量为每次使用一比特。

sentences.en: The two possible outputs still leave uncertainty about which input occurred.
sentences.zh: 两个可能输出仍使原输入存在不确定性。

sentences.en: Are equal row entropies enough if the columns are not balanced?
sentences.zh: 如果列和不平衡，仅有相同的行熵足够吗？

sentences.en: For instance, two identical rows (.9,.1) have row entropy H b of .1, but capacity zero.
sentences.zh: 例如两行均为(.9,.1)，行熵为H_b(.1)，容量却为零。

sentences.en: Their column sums are 1.8 and .2, so the output-entropy upper bound cannot be attained.
sentences.zh: 其列和为1.8和.2，因此无法达到输出熵上界。

sentences.en: Next, break row symmetry and optimize a Z-channel directly.
sentences.zh: 接下来打破行对称性，直接优化Z信道。

scenes.title: The optimal input bias follows from differentiation

sentences.en: In this Z-channel, input zero always produces output zero.
sentences.zh: 在该Z信道中，输入0总产生输出0。

sentences.en: Input one flips to output zero with probability alpha.
sentences.zh: 输入1以概率α翻转为输出0。

sentences.en: Otherwise input one produces output one.
sentences.zh: 否则输入1产生输出1。

sentences.en: Set alpha to .3 and q to the probability of input one.
sentences.zh: 取α=.3，并令q为输入1的概率。

sentences.en: Output one then has probability .7 q.
sentences.zh: 于是输出1的概率为.7q。

sentences.en: The output entropy is binary entropy of .7 q.
sentences.zh: 输出熵为H_b(.7q)。

sentences.en: Given input zero, output entropy is zero.
sentences.zh: 给定输入0时，输出熵为零。

sentences.en: Given input one, output entropy is H b of .3.
sentences.zh: 给定输入1时，输出熵为H_b(.3)。

sentences.en: Average conditional entropy is q times H b of .3.
sentences.zh: 平均条件熵为qH_b(.3)。

sentences.en: Thus I of q is H b of .7 q minus q H b of .3. Does a fair input still maximize it?
sentences.zh: 因此I(q)=H_b(0.7q)−qH_b(0.3)。公平输入仍然能使它最大吗？

sentences.en: Differentiate binary entropy with respect to its probability argument, called R.
sentences.zh: 在内部概率r处对二元熵求导。

sentences.en: Its derivative is log two of one minus r divided by r.
sentences.zh: 其导数为log₂((1−r)/r)。

sentences.en: Apply the chain rule to r equals .7 q.
sentences.zh: 对r=.7q应用链式法则。

sentences.en: The output-entropy derivative contributes .7 log two of the ratio one minus .7 q to .7 q.
sentences.zh: 输出熵的导数贡献.7log₂((1−.7q)/(.7q))。

sentences.en: Subtract H b of .3 to obtain the full derivative of mutual information.
sentences.zh: 再减去H_b(.3)，得到互信息的完整导数。

sentences.en: Set this derivative to zero for the interior optimum.
sentences.zh: 令此导数为零以求内部最优点。

sentences.en: Setting the derivative to zero gives a log ratio equal to H b of .3 divided by .7.
sentences.zh: 令导数为零，得到对数比值等于H_b(.3)/.7。

sentences.en: The denominator is .7 times the quantity one plus two to the entropy ratio.
sentences.zh: 分母是.7乘以“1加2的熵比次方”。

sentences.en: The maximizing q is the reciprocal of that denominator.
sentences.zh: 使互信息最大的q就是该分母的倒数。

sentences.en: The second derivative is negative throughout the interior.
sentences.zh: 该函数在整个内部区间的二阶导数为负。

sentences.en: With r equal .7 q, its second derivative is negative .7 squared divided by ln two times r times one minus r.
sentences.zh: 令r=.7q，其二阶导数为−.7²/[ln2·r(1−r)]。

sentences.en: The optimum input probability is about zero point four two one.
sentences.zh: 最优输入概率约为0.421。

sentences.en: Substitution gives about zero point five zero three seven bits per use.
sentences.zh: 代入得到容量约为每次使用0.5037比特。

sentences.en: These displayed values evaluate the stated formula numerically.
sentences.zh: 这些显示值是对所列公式的数值计算。

sentences.en: They are not measured channel performance.
sentences.zh: 它们不是信道性能测量结果。

sentences.en: At q equal zero, the input is fixed and mutual information is zero.
sentences.zh: q=0时输入固定，互信息为零。

sentences.en: At q equal one, the output is a noisy version of a fixed input.
sentences.zh: q=1时输出是固定输入的带噪版本。

sentences.en: Its output entropy equals its conditional entropy, so information is zero.
sentences.zh: 此时输出熵等于条件熵，故互信息为零。

sentences.en: Strict concavity gives a unique maximizing q between the endpoints.
sentences.zh: 严格凹性保证端点之间存在唯一最大化q。

sentences.en: The maximizing input is not uniform.
sentences.zh: 最优输入并非均匀分布。

sentences.en: Asymmetry makes the two inputs carry different information value.
sentences.zh: 信道不对称使两个输入携带的信息价值不同。

sentences.en: The output marginal probability is the key variable in the entropy term.
sentences.zh: 输出边缘概率是熵项中的关键变量。

sentences.en: Next, establish general capacity properties for finite channels.
sentences.zh: 接下来建立有限信道容量的一般性质。

scenes.title: Outputs are unique at optimum; inputs need not be

sentences.en: For finite input and output alphabets, input laws form a compact simplex.
sentences.zh: 有限输入输出字母表下，输入分布构成紧单纯形。

sentences.en: Mutual information is continuous on that simplex.
sentences.zh: 互信息在该单纯形上连续。

sentences.en: Continuity includes zero probabilities using the limit zero log zero equals zero.
sentences.zh: 连续性通过0log0极限约定延伸到零概率处。

sentences.en: A continuous function on a compact set attains its maximum.
sentences.zh: 紧集上的连续函数可达到最大值。

sentences.en: So a capacity-achieving input exists.
sentences.zh: 因此容量最大化输入存在。

sentences.en: Mutual information is at most H of X and at most H of Y.
sentences.zh: 互信息至多为H(X)，也至多为H(Y)。

sentences.en: These entropies are bounded by log input size and log output size.
sentences.zh: 这两个熵分别不超过输入数和输出数的对数。

sentences.en: Hence capacity is at most log two of the smaller alphabet size.
sentences.zh: 因此容量至多为较小字母表大小的log₂。

sentences.en: Capacity is zero exactly when all channel rows are identical.
sentences.zh: 容量为零当且仅当所有信道行完全相同。

sentences.en: If all rows match, output law does not depend on input.
sentences.zh: 若所有行相同，输出分布便不依赖输入。

sentences.en: Then input and output are independent for every input law.
sentences.zh: 于是任意输入分布下输入与输出都独立。

sentences.en: Mutual information and capacity are zero.
sentences.zh: 互信息与容量均为零。

sentences.en: Now suppose two rows differ.
sentences.zh: 现在假设有两行不同。

sentences.en: Use input only on those two symbols with positive weights.
sentences.zh: 只在这两个符号上取正输入权重。

sentences.en: Let R be the resulting mixture output distribution.
sentences.zh: 令R为由此得到的混合输出分布。

sentences.en: Mutual information equals the weighted sum of divergences from each row to R.
sentences.zh: 互信息等于各行到R的KL散度加权和。

sentences.en: Both divergences are nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 这两个散度均非负。

sentences.en: They cannot both vanish because the two rows differ.
sentences.zh: 由于两行不同，它们不可能同时为零。

sentences.en: Thus this input law gives positive mutual information.
sentences.zh: 因此该输入分布给出正互信息。

sentences.en: Capacity is then positive.
sentences.zh: 于是容量为正。

sentences.en: The maximizing output distribution is unique.
sentences.zh: 最大化输出分布是唯一的。

sentences.en: Suppose two maximizing inputs produce different output laws.
sentences.zh: 假设两个最大化输入产生不同输出分布。

sentences.en: Mix the input distributions with a weight strictly between zero and one.
sentences.zh: 用严格介于0与1之间的权重混合两个输入分布。

sentences.en: The output law is the same mixture of their output laws.
sentences.zh: 输出分布也按相同权重混合。

sentences.en: Entropy is strictly concave between two distinct output laws.
sentences.zh: 两个不同输出分布之间的熵严格凹。

sentences.en: Conditional output entropy is linear in the input distribution.
sentences.zh: 条件输出熵关于输入分布是线性的。

sentences.en: Their difference, mutual information, strictly increases under this mixture.
sentences.zh: 两者之差即互信息，在混合后严格增加。

sentences.en: That contradicts maximality.
sentences.zh: 这与最大性矛盾。

sentences.en: The optimal output law is unique. Must the maximizing input law also be unique?
sentences.zh: 最优输出分布唯一。达到最大值的输入分布也必须唯一吗？

sentences.en: Take three input symbols with rows (one,zero), (one,zero), and (zero,one).
sentences.zh: 取三种输入，对应行分别为(1,0)、(1,0)和(0,1)。

sentences.en: The channel output is a deterministic function of the input group.
sentences.zh: 该信道输出是输入所属类别的确定函数。

sentences.en: Choose input probability one half on symbol three.
sentences.zh: 给符号3分配输入概率二分之一。

sentences.en: Split the remaining half arbitrarily between symbols one and two.
sentences.zh: 将剩余一半任意分给符号1和2。

sentences.en: The output is uniform binary and mutual information equals one bit.
sentences.zh: 输出为公平二元分布，互信息为一比特。

sentences.en: Every such split is optimal, while the output law stays fixed.
sentences.zh: 所有此类拆分均最优，但输出分布保持不变。

sentences.en: This separates uniqueness of the output from uniqueness of the input.
sentences.zh: 这区分了输出唯一性与输入唯一性。

sentences.en: Next, coding theorems will connect capacity to reliable transmission rates.
sentences.zh: 下一集将用编码定理把容量连接到可靠传输速率。
